source.title: The "Nod-don" technique was used for Blindfolded Solving
source.content:
During 3x3 Blindfolded Round 2, a competitor was using the nod-don technique. Immediately after the solve, he informed the WCA Delegates that he thought it might be a bit close to starting the first turn before the blindfold was fully donned. The WCA Delegates granted a provisional extra before asking the WRC for feedback. This might violate Regulations B4a) and B4b):

> [B4a](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#B4a)) The competitor dons the blindfold to start the blindfolded phase.
> 
> [B4b](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#B4b)) The competitor must not apply moves to the puzzle before they have fully donned the blindfold. Penalty: disqualification of the attempt (DNF).

Since the video evidence was not enough to know if the don is legit or not, the WRC agreed to accept the provisional **extra** as the valid result.

translation.title: 盲拧中使用低头戴眼罩技巧
translation.content:
三阶盲拧第二轮中，一名选手使用了低头戴上眼罩的 ‘nod-don’ 技巧。还原结束后，他立即告诉代表，自己认为第一步转动可能接近眼罩尚未完全戴好的时刻。代表在征询 WRC 意见前给予了暂定的额外尝试。这可能违反 B4a 和 B4b：
> [B4a](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#B4a) 选手戴上眼罩，开始盲拧阶段。
> [B4b](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#B4b) 眼罩完全戴好前，选手不得转动魔方，否则该次尝试 DNF。

视频证据不足以判断戴眼罩动作是否合规，因此 WRC 同意将暂定的**额外尝试**作为有效成绩。
